items.title: 14.7 S.H.M. mein tawanai ka tahaffuz (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of conservation of energy in S.H.M. (PDF 31-35).

blocks.text: S.H.M. karne wale jism ke paas potential energy (darmiyani jagah se displacement ki wajah se) aur kinetic energy (velocity ki wajah se) dono hoti hain. Oscillation ke dauran yeh tawanaiyan badalti hain, lekin ragar na ho to kisi bhi lamhe kul tawanai constant rehti hai.

Spring par kamiyat (Fig 14.10) ke liye restoring force x = 0 par sifar aur x = xo par kxo hai, is liye O se xo tak khinchne mein is ki ausat qeemat Fav = (0 + kxo)/2 = (1/2) kxo hai. Spring ko xo tak khainchne ka kaam W = Fav x xo = (1/2) kxo^2 hai, jo elastic potential energy ki shakal mein jama hota hai. Kisi displacement x par P.E. = (1/2) kx^2 (14.22); yeh x = 0 par sifar aur x = +/- xo par zyada se zyada hai: (P.E.)max = (1/2) kxo^2 (14.23).

Displacement x par raftar v = w x (xo^2 - x^2) ka square root = [(k/m)(xo^2 - x^2)] ka square root (14.24) hai, aur x = 0 par zyada se zyada v_max = (k/m) ka square root x xo (14.25). Is liye K.E. = (1/2) mv^2 = (1/2) k(xo^2 - x^2) (14.26). Darmiyani jagah par P.E. sifar aur kul tawanai sirf kinetic hai: T.E. = (K.E.)max = (1/2) kxo^2 (14.27). Kisi bhi displacement par T.E. = K.E. + P.E. = (1/2) k(xo^2 - x^2) + (1/2) kx^2 = (1/2) kxo^2 (14.28). Kyunke k = m w^2, T.E. = (1/2) m w^2 xo^2 (14.29).

Yun mass-spring nizam ki kul tawanai constant aur amplitude ke square ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. Tawanai ka yeh tahaffuz S.H.M. karne wale tamam ajsam par laagu hai. Jab K.E. zyada se zyada ho to kamiyat oscillation ke markaz se guzar rahi hoti aur P.E. sifar hoti hai; jab P.E. zyada se zyada ho to kamiyat inteha par aur K.E. sifar hoti hai. Tawanai K.E. aur P.E. ke darmiyan aati jati hai, lekin un ka jor constant rehta hai (Fig 14.11). Kitab ki Fig 14.10 latakti kamiyaton se khinche mukhtalif rang ke springs dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: -xo se +xo tak displacement ke muqable tawanai ka graph. Neela oopar khulta parabola, P.E. = (1/2)kx^2, markaz par sifar aur siron par sab se ooncha. Surkh neeche khulta parabola, K.E. = (1/2)k(xo^2 - x^2), markaz par sab se ooncha aur siron par sifar. Dashed purple ufqi lakeer, kul = (1/2)kxo^2, dono curves ko un ki inteha par chhooti. Curves aadhi oonchai par aik doosre ko kaat'te hain.
blocks.caption: S.H.M. mein kinetic, potential aur kul tawanai (Fig 14.11 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Har displacement par surkh aur neeli oonchaiyan mil kar dashed lakeer ke barabar hain: tawanai sirf kinetic aur potential ke darmiyan shakal badalti hai.

blocks.text: 0.010 kg kamiyat ka jism 6 s period se S.H.M. karta hai. Darmiyani jagah se guzarne ke aik second baad us ki raftar 0.06 m s^-1 hai. Us ki kinetic energy, potential energy aur kul tawanai maloom karein. Hal: w = 2 pi / T = 2 pi / 6 = pi/3 rad s^-1, taqreeban 1.047 rad s^-1. K.E. = (1/2) mv^2 = (1/2)(0.010)(0.06)^2 = 1.8 x 10^-5 J. Waqt darmiyani jagah se napein to x = xo sin(wt) aur v = xo w cos(wt). t = 1 s par wt = pi/3 aur cos(pi/3) = 0.5, is liye 0.06 = xo (1.047)(0.5) aur xo = 0.115 m. Kul tawanai E = (1/2) m w^2 xo^2 = (1/2)(0.010)(1.047)^2(0.115)^2 = 7.2 x 10^-5 J. P.E. = E - K.E. = 7.2 x 10^-5 - 1.8 x 10^-5 = 5.4 x 10^-5 J. (Jaanch: x = xo sin(pi/3) = 0.099 m aur (1/2) m w^2 x^2 = 5.4 x 10^-5 J.)

blocks.title: Kitab mein Misal 14.5
blocks.text: Kitab v = xo w sin(wt) aur sin(pi/3) = 0.866 use kar ke xo = 0.066 m, E = 2.4 x 10^-5 J aur P.E. = 0.6 x 10^-5 J nikalti hai. Woh formula waqt inteha ki jagah se napta hai, darmiyani jagah se nahi jaisa sawal kehta hai. Darmiyani jagah se napein to jawab xo = 0.115 m, E = 7.2 x 10^-5 J aur P.E. = 5.4 x 10^-5 J hain (K.E. dono suraton mein 1.8 x 10^-5 J). Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

blocks.prompt: Agar S.H.M. ka amplitude dugna kar diya jaye to kul tawanai ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar guna ho jati hai, kyunke kul tawanai (1/2) kxo^2 amplitude ke square ke mutanasib hai.

items: T.E. = (1/2) kxo^2 = (1/2) m w^2 xo^2: constant, amplitude ke square ke mutanasib.
O par sab K.E.; intehaon par sab P.E.
